entries.meaningZh: 淀粉纤维素〔旧化学用语〕
entries.en: The craftsman's amylo-cellulose paste had dried on the split wooden frame before it could be repaired.
entries.zh: 修理开始之前，工匠所用的淀粉纤维素糊已经干在那副开裂的木框上了。

entries.en: The historian compared two early drawings of amylobacter rather than treating the sketches as modern micrographs.
entries.zh: 历史研究者比较了两幅早期淀粉杆菌图，没有把这些素描当成现代显微照片。

entries.en: The archive contained a receipt for amylocaine but no record of who had ordered it.
entries.zh: 档案中有一张购买阿米洛卡因的收据，却没有记载是谁订购的。

entries.en: The comparison of amyloclast activity used separate records for the two extracts.
entries.zh: 比较两种提取液的淀粉分解酶活性时，使用了分别记录的数据。

entries.meaningZh: 淀粉凝固酶〔历史研究用语〕
entries.en: The old experiment attributed the starch precipitate to amylocoagulase, but its control results were missing.
entries.zh: 那项旧实验把淀粉沉淀归因于淀粉凝固酶，但它的对照结果遗失了。

entries.en: The laboratory compared the amylodextrin samples before deciding whether their results could be combined.
entries.zh: 实验室先比较了那些淀粉糊精样品，再决定能否合并结果。

entries.en: The old case history described amylodyspepsia but gave little detail about the patient's usual meals.
entries.zh: 那份旧病历记述了淀粉消化不良，却很少提到患者平时的饮食。

entries.en: The museum displayed an unopened packet of amyloform beside the pharmacy's original stock book.
entries.zh: 博物馆把一包未开封的淀粉仿与药房原来的库存账簿一起展出。

entries.en: The analyst kept the amylogen results separate from the measurements of the insoluble residue.
entries.zh: 分析人员把淀粉溶质的检测结果与不溶性残留物的测量数据分开保存。

entries.en: The student drew the amylogenic bodies more clearly in the second version of the plant-cell diagram.
entries.zh: 学生在第二版植物细胞图中，把生成淀粉的颗粒画得更清楚了。

entries.en: The historical discussion of amyloidemia distinguished blood observations from findings in the surrounding tissues.
entries.zh: 那篇有关淀粉样蛋白血症的历史论述，把血液观察结果与周围组织中的发现区分开来。

entries.en: The pathologist requested clearer tissue illustrations before commenting on the account of amyloidopathia.
entries.zh: 病理学家要求提供更清楚的组织图，之后才愿意评论那份淀粉样蛋白病记述。

entries.en: The researcher compared specimens of the genus Amylomyces without assuming that they belonged to the same species.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了淀粉霉属的标本，没有直接认定它们属于同一种。

entries.en: The paper reported amylopectase activity separately for each of the three extracts.
entries.zh: 论文分别报告了三种提取液的支链淀粉酶活性。

entries.en: The interview explored her amylophagia and the amount of starch she had been eating.
entries.zh: 那次访谈了解了她的食淀粉癖，以及她一直以来食用淀粉的量。

entries.en: The reviewer asked whether the reported amylophosphatase activity had been measured in every sample.
entries.zh: 审稿人询问，是否每份样品都测定了所报告的淀粉磷酸酶活性。

entries.en: A missing control made the comparison of amylophosphorylase activity difficult to interpret.
entries.zh: 缺少一项对照，使淀粉磷酸化酶活性的比较难以解释。

entries.en: The student drew an amyloplast beside the nucleus but forgot to include the starch grains.
entries.zh: 学生在细胞核旁画了一个造粉体，却忘了画出淀粉粒。

entries.en: The botanical diagram contrasts amyloplastic tissue with the structures that carry water through the plant.
entries.zh: 那幅植物学图把生成淀粉的组织与植物中输送水分的结构作了对比。

entries.en: The researcher compared amylopsin activity in two pancreatic extracts without drawing conclusions from a single reading.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了两种胰提取液的胰淀粉酶活性，没有根据一次读数就下结论。

entries.en: The report on amylorrhea included stool findings but no account of the patient's diet.
entries.zh: 那份有关淀粉溢的报告记载了粪便检查结果，却没有说明患者的饮食情况。

entries.en: The diagram of amylorrhexis showed the starting material on a separate panel from the products.
entries.zh: 那幅淀粉酶水解作用图，把起始材料与产物画在不同的图框中。

entries.en: Two samples with similar amylose content produced different results in the comparison.
entries.zh: 两份直链淀粉含量相近的样品，在比较中得出了不同结果。

entries.en: The historical note on amylosuria did not say how the starch in the urine had been identified.
entries.zh: 那则有关淀粉尿的历史记录，没有说明尿中的淀粉是如何被鉴定出来的。

entries.en: Before discussing amyluria, the author checked whether the urine sample might have been contaminated.
entries.zh: 讨论淀粉尿之前，作者先核查了尿样是否可能受到污染。

entries.en: The curator compared the Amynodontidae jaw fragments with enlarged photographs before preparing the fossil display.
entries.zh: 策展人先将两栖犀科颌骨碎片与放大的照片作比较，再准备化石展览。

entries.en: The chapter's amynologic discussion focused on the host rather than on the parasite's shape.
entries.zh: 那一章的免疫学讨论侧重宿主，而不是寄生虫的形状。

entries.en: The lecture on the history of amynology was followed by a discussion of the evidence available at the time.
entries.zh: 那场有关免疫学历史的讲座之后，大家讨论了当时能够获得的证据。

entries.en: The examination distinguished amyo-esthesia from loss of skin sensation in the same arm.
entries.zh: 那次检查把肌觉缺失与同一条手臂的皮肤感觉缺失区分开来。

entries.en: The old case notes contrasted amyo-esthesis with the patient's preserved sensitivity to light touches on the skin.
entries.zh: 那份旧病历把肌觉缺失与患者仍然保留的皮肤轻触觉作了对照。

entries.en: The anatomical study compared the distribution of amyoplasia in the two preserved drawings.
entries.zh: 那项解剖研究比较了两幅保存下来的图中肌发育不全的分布。

entries.en: The physician recorded amyostasia when the patient tried to stand without support.
entries.zh: 患者试着在没有支撑的情况下站立时，医生记录到了肌震颤。

entries.en: The old case notes describe an amyostatic patient who needed support while standing.
entries.zh: 那份旧病历描述了一位站立时需要支撑的肌震颤患者。

entries.en: The account of amyosthenia distinguished difficulty lifting the arm from pain during movement.
entries.zh: 那份肌无力记述，把抬臂困难与运动时的疼痛区分开来。

entries.en: The physician compared the amyosthenic patient's earlier movements with those shown in the later record.
entries.zh: 医生把那位肌无力患者早先的动作，与较晚记录中的动作作了比较。

entries.en: The study of amyotaxia compared the patient's attempts to reach the same point on successive occasions.
entries.zh: 那项肌共济失调研究比较了患者在不同次尝试中伸手触及同一位置的表现。

entries.en: The diagram contrasts an amyous region with the muscle-rich tissue beside it.
entries.zh: 那幅图把一处无肌区域与其旁边富含肌肉的组织作了对比。

entries.en: The botanist compared two pressed specimens of Amyris before arranging them in the collection.
entries.zh: 植物学家比较了两份压制的阿米香树属标本，然后才将它们整理入藏。

entries.en: The old account of amyxorrhea recorded dryness but did not identify the reason for the reduced secretion.
entries.zh: 那份有关粘液分泌缺乏的旧记述记录了干燥现象，却没有查明分泌减少的原因。

entries.en: The student compared drawings of Anabantidae from two editions of the fish atlas.
entries.zh: 学生比较了两版鱼类图谱中的攀鲈科图画。

entries.en: The older classification placed Anabantoidei in a different part of the display from the newer chart.
entries.zh: 那套较旧的分类把攀鲈亚目放在了展板上与新版分类图不同的位置。

entries.en: The chronicler's account of the anabasis ended before the army reached the mountain pass.
entries.zh: 编年史作者对那次远征的记述，在军队抵达山口之前就结束了。

entries.en: The diagram separated anabolistic processes from those involving the breakdown of complex molecules.
entries.zh: 那幅图把组成代谢过程与涉及复杂分子分解的过程区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 同化产物；组成代谢产物
entries.en: The researcher wanted to identify the anabolite before proposing how it had been formed.
entries.zh: 研究人员想先鉴定那种同化产物，再提出它可能如何形成。

entries.en: The historical case report described anabrosis along the edge of the damaged tissue.
entries.zh: 那份历史病例报告描述了受损组织边缘的糜烂。

entries.en: The illustration showed an anabrotic change beside a region that appeared intact.
entries.zh: 图中画出了一处糜烂性变化，其旁边的区域看起来仍完整。

entries.en: The chemist requested a fresh analysis of anabsinthin before accepting the proposed molecular structure.
entries.zh: 化学家要求重新分析安艾苦素，之后才愿意接受所提出的分子结构。

entries.en: The anatomical sketch showed anacampsis at the joint without illustrating how the movement had occurred.
entries.zh: 那幅解剖素描画出了关节的弯曲，却没有说明这一运动如何发生。

entries.en: The old fish catalogue arranged the Anacanthini drawings on a separate plate.
entries.zh: 那本旧鱼类目录把无棘类图画排在单独一幅图版上。

entries.en: The herbarium moved its Anacardiaceae specimens to a larger cabinet during the renovation.
entries.zh: 翻修期间，植物标本馆把漆树科标本移进了一个更大的柜子。

entries.en: The historical record described prolonged anacatharsis but gave no clear account of its onset.
entries.zh: 那份历史记录描述了持续的剧吐，却没有清楚记载开始的情况。

entries.en: The historical account questioned the mixture's claimed anacathartic effects rather than recommending its use.
entries.zh: 那份历史记述质疑了该混合物所宣称的剧烈催吐作用，并没有建议使用它。

entries.en: The reviewer questioned whether anachoresis explained the bacteria found in the damaged tissue.
entries.zh: 审稿人质疑，引菌作用是否能解释受损组织中发现的细菌。

entries.en: The paper discussed a possible anachoretic process but did not establish where the bacteria had originated.
entries.zh: 论文讨论了一种可能的引菌过程，却没有确定细菌来自哪里。

entries.en: The proposed anachoric explanation still needed evidence linking the bacteria to the affected region.
entries.zh: 所提出的引菌解释，仍然需要把细菌与患处联系起来的证据。

entries.en: The old report described an anacid sample but supplied no measurement of its acidity.
entries.zh: 那份旧报告描述了一份酸度不足的样品，却没有提供酸度测量结果。

entries.en: The discussion of anacidity relied on measurements of gastric secretion rather than on symptoms alone.
entries.zh: 关于胃酸缺乏的讨论依据的是胃分泌液的测量，而不仅是症状。

entries.en: The investigation of anacidogenesis focused on acid production rather than on how much food had been eaten.
entries.zh: 那项成酸不能研究侧重酸的生成，而不是进食量。

entries.en: The optical diagram of anaclasis was redrawn because the path of the light was unclear.
entries.zh: 那幅有关光折射的光学图被重新绘制了，因为光的路径不清楚。

entries.en: The historical case notes described anacousia without specifying whether either ear had retained any hearing.
entries.zh: 那份历史病历描述了耳聋，却没有说明任何一侧耳朵是否还保有听力。

entries.en: The seminar compared two translations of Anacreon without treating either as a substitute for the original poems.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了两种阿克那里翁诗作译本，没有把任何一种当成原诗的替代品。

entries.en: The cheerful Anacreontic verses offered a sharp contrast to the solemn poem that followed.
entries.zh: 那些明快、饮酒谈情的诗句，与后面那首庄重的诗形成了鲜明对比。

entries.meaningZh: 升线脉波异常的〔脉搏描记上升支出现次级切迹〕
entries.en: The anacrotic pulse tracing was too faint to compare reliably with the original figure.
entries.zh: 那张有升线脉波异常的描记图太模糊，无法与原图作可靠比较。

entries.meaningZh: 升线脉波异常〔脉搏描记上升支出现次级切迹〕
entries.en: The historian rechecked the original tracing before accepting the author's account of anacrotism.
entries.zh: 历史研究者重新核对了原始描记图，然后才接受作者对升线脉波异常的记述。

entries.en: The interview about anacusia relied on written questions rather than on the spoken instructions used earlier.
entries.zh: 那次有关耳聋的访谈依靠书面问题，而不是先前使用的口头说明。

entries.en: The old case history recorded anacusis in both ears and described how the patient communicated in writing.
entries.zh: 那份旧病历记载了双耳失聪，并描述了患者如何用书写交流。

entries.en: The anatomical study distinguished anadenia from damage to a gland that had developed normally.
entries.zh: 那项解剖研究把腺缺失与正常发育后的腺体损伤区分开来。

entries.en: The thin anadesma was easier to follow in the enlarged anatomical drawing.
entries.zh: 在放大的解剖图中，那层薄筋膜更容易辨认。

entries.en: The student compared the anadicrotic tracing with the smoother curve on the opposite page.
entries.zh: 学生把那张升线二波脉描记图，与对页较平滑的曲线作了比较。

entries.en: The observer marked anadicrotism on the chart but left the timing of the recording unclear.
entries.zh: 观察者在图表上标出了升线二波脉现象，却没有清楚记载记录时间。

entries.en: The old case history described anadipsia but did not record how long the intense thirst had lasted.
entries.zh: 那份旧病历描述了剧渴，却没有记载这种强烈口渴持续了多久。

entries.en: The historical discussion of anadrenalism lacked the functional measurements needed to assess its central claim.
entries.zh: 那篇有关肾上腺机能缺失的历史论述，缺少评估其核心论断所需的功能测量数据。

entries.en: The physician's notes on anadrenia separated the examination findings from the family's account of earlier symptoms.
entries.zh: 医生关于肾上腺机能缺失的笔记，把检查结果与家属对先前症状的描述分开记录。

entries.en: The research team studied anadromy by tracking fish as they returned upstream to spawn.
entries.zh: 研究团队跟踪鱼类返回上游产卵的路线，以研究溯河产卵。

entries.en: The coastal survey included several specimens of Anadyomenaceae from the same collection site.
entries.zh: 那次沿海调查收集了来自同一采集地点的几份网膜藻科标本。

entries.meaningZh: Anadyomene〔希腊神话中的爱与美女神〕
entries.en: The painting showed Anadyomene rising above a band of dark water beneath the pale sky.
entries.zh: 那幅画中，爱与美女神从一带暗色水面上升起，上方是淡色的天空。

entries.en: The travel diary contained a sketch of a bridge over the Anadyr but no date for the drawing.
entries.zh: 那本旅行日记里有一幅阿纳德尔河上一座桥的素描，却没有标注绘制日期。

entries.en: The report on anaematopoiesis needed a clearer distinction between blood-cell production and blood-cell loss.
entries.zh: 那份造血机能不足报告需要更清楚地区分血细胞生成与血细胞丢失。

entries.en: The anaerobia in the comparison were recorded separately from organisms that required oxygen.
entries.zh: 比较研究中，厌氧菌与需要氧气的生物被分开记录。

entries.en: The team compared the anaerobian populations in two sediment samples from different depths.
entries.zh: 团队比较了来自不同深度的两份沉积物样品中的厌氧生物种群。

entries.en: The study followed anaerobious growth in the samples without assuming that every organism behaved alike.
entries.zh: 研究追踪了样品中的厌氧生长情况，没有假定所有生物的表现都相同。

entries.en: Their comparison of anaerobism did not establish whether the organisms could also tolerate oxygen.
entries.zh: 他们对厌氧生活力的比较，没有确定那些生物是否也能耐受氧气。

entries.en: The paper compared anaerogenic strains with strains that produced visible gas.
entries.zh: 论文把不产气菌株与会产生可见气体的菌株作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 排气疗法〔历史创伤处理用语〕
entries.en: The surgeon's account of anaeroplasty omitted any comparison with wounds left exposed to air.
entries.zh: 外科医生对排气疗法的记述，没有与仍暴露在空气中的创伤作任何比较。

entries.meaningZh: 感觉与运动能力缺失〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The case notes contrasted anaesthecinesis in the left arm with preserved movement and sensation on the right.
entries.zh: 那份病历把左臂的感觉与运动能力缺失，与右臂仍然保留的运动能力和感觉作了对照。

entries.en: The chromatogram for anaesthesin was compared with a benzocaine reference sample before the report was completed.
entries.zh: 报告完成前，阿奈西辛的色谱图与苯佐卡因对照样品作了比较。

entries.en: The gardener compared the old Anagallis illustrations with pressed specimens in the herbarium.
entries.zh: 园丁把旧的琉璃繁缕属插图与植物标本馆里的压制标本作了比较。

entries.en: The analysis of anagestone was repeated because the first record did not identify the sample clearly.
entries.zh: 由于第一份记录没有清楚标明样品，阿那孕酮分析被重新做了一次。

entries.meaningZh: 机能性厌读〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The physician's interview about anagnosasthenia focused on the distress that arose during reading.
entries.zh: 医生关于机能性厌读的访谈，侧重阅读过程中出现的不适。

entries.en: The chemist checked the anagyrine results against the original measurements before revising the table.
entries.zh: 化学家修改表格前，把臭豆碱的检测结果与原始测量数据作了核对。

entries.en: The historical account of anahaematopoiesis gave blood measurements but no evidence about the rate of cell formation.
entries.zh: 那份有关造血机能不足的历史记述，提供了血液测量数据，却没有给出细胞生成速率的证据。

entries.en: The historian compared the early illustrations of anakhre without accepting every explanation offered by their authors.
entries.zh: 历史研究者比较了早期根度病插图，没有接受各位作者提出的每一种解释。

entries.en: The examination record noted anakusis but did not say which communication method the patient preferred.
entries.zh: 检查记录写到了耳聋，却没有说明患者更愿意采用哪种交流方式。

entries.en: The collector photographed the analcime crystals before returning the specimen to its padded box.
entries.zh: 收藏者先拍下方沸石晶体，再把标本放回有软垫的盒子里。

entries.en: The pale analcite stood out clearly against the darker rock in the enlarged photograph.
entries.zh: 在放大的照片中，浅色方沸石与较暗的岩石形成鲜明对比。

entries.en: The laboratory report compared analgen with two other powders but gave no purity measurements.
entries.zh: 实验室报告把安纳晶与另外两种粉末作了比较，却没有提供纯度测量数据。

entries.en: The invoice charged separately for analgene and for the glass containers used to transport it.
entries.zh: 发票对安纳晶和运输它所用的玻璃容器分别计费。

entries.en: The old examination record described analgia in the left hand, with sensitivity to light touch still preserved.
entries.zh: 那份旧检查记录描述了左手痛觉缺失，但轻触觉仍然保留。

entries.en: The physician marked the analgic area on a sketch of the patient's arm.
entries.zh: 医生在患者手臂的素描上标出了痛觉缺失的区域。

entries.en: The pharmacy's historical inventory recorded Analgin separately from the surgical supplies.
entries.zh: 药房的历史库存清单把安乃近与外科用品分开登记。

entries.en: The researchers questioned whether the serum was truly anallergic under the conditions described.
entries.zh: 研究人员质疑，在所述条件下，那份血清是否真的不会引起过敏。

entries.meaningZh: 分析器〔感觉生理学用语〕
entries.en: On the diagram, the lecturer traced the visual analysor from the eye to its cerebral connections.
entries.zh: 讲师在图上沿着视觉分析器，从眼部追溯到它与大脑的连接。

entries.en: The faded map of Anam was kept with the traveller's unfinished account of the journey.
entries.zh: 那幅褪色的安南地图，与旅行者尚未写完的行程记述放在一起。

entries.en: The museum kept its Aname specimens in separate drawers from the photographs of living spiders.
entries.zh: 博物馆把安纳米蜘蛛属标本与活蜘蛛的照片分别存放在不同抽屉里。

entries.en: The botanist checked the Anamirta specimen against the older illustration before revising the catalogue.
entries.zh: 植物学家修订目录前，把那份印防己属标本与较早的插图作了核对。

entries.en: The chemist questioned the proposed structure of anamirtin because the analysis was incomplete.
entries.zh: 由于分析不完整，化学家对所提出的印防己甙结构提出了质疑。

entries.en: The lecture compared the traditional grouping Anamnia with the categories used in a newer textbook.
entries.zh: 讲座比较了传统的无羊膜动物类划分与一本较新教材采用的分类。

entries.en: The old zoological chart placed Anamniota beside a separate panel illustrating amniotic development.
entries.zh: 那幅旧动物学分类图在无羊膜动物类旁，另设一个图框来展示羊膜发育。

entries.en: The student chose an anamniote for comparison with the amniotic embryo in the next drawing.
entries.zh: 学生选了一种无羊膜动物，与下一幅图中的羊膜动物胚胎作比较。

entries.en: The illustration compared anamniotic development with the arrangement shown in the amniotic embryo.
entries.zh: 插图把无羊膜发育与羊膜动物胚胎中的结构排列作了比较。

entries.en: The historical account of ananabasia distinguished difficulty ascending from an inability to move the legs.
entries.zh: 那份登高不能的历史记述，把向上攀登困难与双腿无法运动区分开来。

entries.en: The old notes on ananastasia described the patient's attempts to rise from chairs of different heights.
entries.zh: 那份有关起立不能的旧笔记，描述了患者尝试从不同高度的椅子上站起的表现。

entries.en: The historical account of anancastia described repeated actions but gave little information about the patient's own experience.
entries.zh: 那份有关强迫状态的历史记述描述了重复行为，却很少涉及患者本人的感受。

entries.en: The curator compared the Anancinae drawings with photographs of the fossils before arranging the exhibition.
entries.zh: 策展人布展前，把互稜齿象亚科图画与化石照片作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 男征缺失〔历史医学用语〕
entries.en: The old case notes described anandria without distinguishing physical characteristics from reproductive function.
entries.zh: 那份旧病历记述了男征缺失，却没有把身体特征与生殖功能区分开来。

entries.en: The apparently anangioid region was drawn without vessels, but the sketch did not prove their absence.
entries.zh: 图中那片似乎无血管的区域没有画出血管，但这幅素描并不能证明那里确实没有血管。

entries.en: The anatomical study compared the extent of anangioplasia in two preserved tissue drawings.
entries.zh: 那项解剖研究比较了两幅保存下来的组织图中血管发育不全的范围。

entries.en: The report on anangioplasis needed clearer images of the smaller vessels before its conclusion could be assessed.
entries.zh: 那份血管发育不全报告需要更清楚的小血管图像，之后才能评估其结论。

entries.en: Anangioplasm was noted in the old description, but the accompanying drawing showed only the larger vessels.
entries.zh: 旧记述中提到了血管发育不全，可配图只画出了较大的血管。

entries.en: The anangioplastic region was outlined separately from the surrounding tissue in the anatomical plate.
entries.zh: 在那幅解剖图版中，血管发育不全的区域被单独勾出，与周围组织区分开来。

entries.en: The astronomy club searched the image for Ananke but could not separate it from the background stars.
entries.zh: 天文俱乐部在图像中寻找木卫十二，却无法把它与背景恒星区分开来。

entries.en: The old botanical plate placed ananthous plants in a separate panel from the flowering specimens.
entries.zh: 那幅旧植物学图版，把无花植物与开花标本画在不同的图框中。

entries.en: The mineralogist examined the anapaite beside the broken edge of the darker surrounding rock.
entries.zh: 矿物学家检查了那块较暗围岩断裂边缘旁的三斜磷钙铁矿。

entries.meaningZh: 过度使用所致的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historical discussion of anapeiratic cramp included detailed accounts of repetitive writing tasks.
entries.zh: 那篇有关过度使用所致痉挛的历史论述，详细记载了反复书写的任务。

entries.en: The old portrait showed the man's anaphalantiasis more clearly than the brief case notes did.
entries.zh: 那幅旧肖像比简短的病历更清楚地展示了那名男子的眉毛脱落情况。

entries.en: The herbarium stored the Anaphalis specimens with the original field notes rather than with the later copies.
entries.zh: 植物标本馆把香青属标本与原始野外笔记一起保存，没有与后来的抄本放在一起。

entries.en: The examination recorded anaphia in a small region rather than assuming that the whole hand was affected.
entries.zh: 检查记录了一小片区域的触觉缺失，没有直接认定整只手都受到影响。

entries.en: The historian found no outcome records accompanying the notes on anaphonesis.
entries.zh: 历史研究者没有找到与高声疗法笔记相配套的结果记录。

entries.en: The notes on anaphoresis recorded the affected area rather than assuming that sweating had stopped everywhere.
entries.zh: 有关汗腺机能减退的笔记记录了受影响的区域，没有直接认定全身都停止了出汗。

entries.en: The old eye chart recorded anaphoria separately from the patient's complaints about blurred vision.
entries.zh: 那张旧眼科检查表把上隐斜眼与患者对视力模糊的主诉分开记录。

entries.en: The case notes on anaphylactia did not identify what had triggered the reaction.
entries.zh: 那份过敏性病病历没有查明是什么触发了反应。

entries.en: The investigator compared two suspected sources of the anaphylactogen before drawing any conclusion.
entries.zh: 调查者在下结论之前，比较了那种过敏原的两个可疑来源。

entries.meaningZh: 发生过敏性的；引发过敏反应的
entries.en: The researchers questioned the anaphylactogenic activity attributed to the preparation.
entries.zh: 研究人员质疑该制剂是否具有所说的引发过敏反应的活性。

entries.en: The early experiment reported a reaction to the serum but did not establish that anaphylactotoxin was responsible.
entries.zh: 那项早期实验报告了对该血清的反应，但没有证实该反应由过敏毒素造成。

entries.en: The historical paper discussed anaphylotoxin as a proposed explanation, not as a substance it had successfully purified.
entries.zh: 那篇历史论文把过敏毒素作为一种假说来讨论，并没有声称自己已成功将其纯化。

entries.en: The researcher compared the Anaplasmataceae grouping in two taxonomic charts without assuming their boundaries were identical.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了两幅分类图中的无形小体科划分，没有假定二者的分类范围完全相同。

entries.en: The old chart recorded the return of anapnea after a long interval with no written observations.
entries.zh: 在很长一段没有书面观察记录的间隔后，那张旧图表记载了呼吸的恢复。

entries.en: The anatomical drawing showed a small crack near the anapophysis of the lumbar vertebra.
entries.zh: 那幅解剖图画出了腰椎副突附近的一条小裂纹。

entries.en: The lecture compared the old grouping Anapsida with more recent classifications of reptiles.
entries.zh: 讲座比较了旧的缺弓亚纲划分与较新的爬行动物分类。

entries.en: The physician outlined the anaptic region on the drawing before noting the other sensory findings.
entries.zh: 医生先在图上勾出了触觉缺失区域，然后才记录其他感觉检查结果。

entries.en: The museum kept the Anarhichadidae photographs beside the drawings used in its older fish catalogue.
entries.zh: 博物馆把狼鱼科照片放在旧鱼类目录采用的图画旁边。

entries.en: The survey included specimens of the genus Anarhichas but did not identify every fish to species level.
entries.zh: 调查中有狼鱼属标本，但没有把每条鱼都鉴定到种。

entries.en: The anatomical plate showed an anaric specimen from both the front and the side.
entries.zh: 那幅解剖图版从正面和侧面展示了一份无鼻标本。

entries.en: The old assessment of anarithmia separated difficulty using numbers from difficulty reading the written questions.
entries.zh: 那份旧的计算不能评估，把运用数字的困难与阅读书面问题的困难区分开来。

entries.en: The exercise asks us to compare anarthrous noun phrases with phrases that contain a definite article.
entries.zh: 那道练习要求我们比较不用冠词的名词短语与含定冠词的短语。

entries.en: Anasa set an extra place at the table when another guest arrived unexpectedly.
entries.zh: 又有一位客人意外到来时，阿纳萨在餐桌上多摆了一套餐具。

entries.en: The curator kept the old Anasca classification beside the specimen drawings for historical comparison.
entries.zh: 策展人把旧的无囊亚目分类与标本图放在一起，供历史比较。

entries.en: The anatomical drawing showed an anaschistic defect extending along the length of the structure.
entries.zh: 那幅解剖图显示了一处沿结构纵向延伸的纵裂缺损。

entries.en: The historical account distinguished the anascitic patient from another case with fluid in the abdominal cavity.
entries.zh: 那份历史记述，把无腹水患者与另一例腹腔有积液的病例区分开来。

entries.en: The palaeontology class compared drawings of Anaspida with photographs of the fossil material.
entries.zh: 古生物学课上，大家把缺甲鱼目图画与化石材料的照片作了比较。

entries.en: The freshwater survey included specimens of Anaspididae but stopped short of a species-level identification.
entries.zh: 那次淡水调查收集了山虾科标本，但没有进一步鉴定到种。

entries.en: The historical review questioned the claimed anastaltic action because the comparison lacked a control.
entries.zh: 由于比较中缺少对照，那篇历史综述质疑了所宣称的收敛止血作用。

entries.en: The chemist wanted to identify the anastate before explaining the process that had produced it.
entries.zh: 化学家想先鉴定那种同化产物，再解释生成它的过程。
